{{Top|leg}}
The '''Trial of Fire''' was the process by which [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] learned new [[Dathomir Magic|spells]]. By using this method, Nightsisters could learn new spells in an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]], rather than taking [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] like the [[Witches of Dathomir|Witches]] did during the [[Time of Learning]]. However, learning the spell in such a short amount of time was dangerous, and would potentially backfire and kill or injure the Nightsister.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
